title: Pyro SAI: fire weather under stratospheric aerosol injection (GeoMIP G6-1.5K analysis code)
description: Analysis code and results for the Pyro SAI project (funded by Reflective). The pipeline computes daily Canadian Fire Weather Index (FWI) and vapor pressure deficit (VPD) from GeoMIP G6-1.5K-SAI, G6-1.5K-HiLLA and SSP2-4.5 daily output of CESM2-WACCM, MIROC-ES2H and UKESM1-1, quantifies changes in extreme fire-weather days relative to local 95th-percentile thresholds of the 1.5 K target climate (SSP2-4.5, 2020-2039), decomposes VPD changes into temperature and humidity contributions, and classifies regions by whether SAI offsets fire-weather drying.
